payload.title: File:Dinosaur size.svg
payload.credit_html: Slate Weasel's silhouettes, Anaxibia's bird size comparison (File:Pelagornis sandersi compare size.png), and Matt Martyniuk's Shantungosaurus (File:Largestdinosaursbysuborder scale.png) and Triceratops (File:Eotriceratops scale.png).
payload.description_html: SVG version of https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Dinosaur_size.png. From left to right: Shantungosaurus, Spinosaurus, human, Supersaurus, Triceratops, Andean condor, Pelagornis, wandering albatross, Stegosaurus and Triceratops.
